title: docs(pm-dispatch): X0 quote policy — date pointers for non-operative maintainer quotations (item 2 of the skills batch, ruling B)
body:
Fixes #14859
Part of #14685
Part of #13597

Item **2** of decision batch 3 (X0 quote policy), executed on the skills lane. Ruling **C** on the batch card (comment 5520452691, verbatim): "**C** — inside `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, a maintainer ruling is quoted verbatim only where the quoted text is itself the operative criterion; everywhere else the quotation becomes a date plus a pointer to the authoritative GitHub comment. The boundary is judged site by site by the executing dev and verified item by item at ACCEPT." Replacement form ruled **B** on the ruling card (comment 5523304679, verbatim): "**Ruled: B.** … at the 44 "pointer-eligible" sites in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, the verbatim quotation is replaced by `（YYYY-MM-DD 裁定）` with the rule stated by the surrounding text (which the classification already verified at every one of the 44); the 5 KEEP sites keep their verbatim quotes; the 4 frame-sync sites are untouched. No issue numbers (the 2026-08-12 ruling 「保留 issue id 没有意义」 stands and `check-skill-id-lint` keeps enforcing it), no bare comment ids (a pointer nobody can dereference is not provenance)."

Governed surface (`.claude/**`): this PR stays **draft**; the seat runs the contract review in-seat and then requests human review. Labels: `skip-changeset` (these paths release nothing) and `needs:contract-review`. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1 (durable attribution; the footer form is create-only).

## What was done

- **Stage 1 (the ruled deliverable, two commits):** at every pointer-eligible site in `SKILL.md` and `os-dev.md` the quotation span — the 「…」 text plus the lead-in that only introduced it (维护者 / 原话 / 逐字 / 拍板 …) — became `（YYYY-MM-DD 裁定）` with the date the text already gave. Full-width parentheses, one token per distinct date; where two quotes shared one attribution they share one token. The 5 KEEP sites are unchanged, the 4 frame-sync sites untouched, and the one undated quote (`SKILL.md` 「明显的问题直接修…」) is kept as NODATE. Both files were byte-identical to the first flight's base `f3ae441fa2` at my base `a6d278ba26` (blob ids `825912b9…` / `42fc96f5…` on both), so every enumerated site re-located by text at its original line.
- **Stage 2 (references/**, one commit per file, whole files only):** the same census rule and the same KEEP / POINTER criteria applied to `contract-review.md`, `decision-analysis.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `landing-operations.md`, `lanes/director.md`, `seat-post-protocol.md`. Files classified and left untouched: `compile-surfaces.md` (0 sites), `platform-readings.md` (0 sites — its 60 bracket spans are term markers and quoted API output), `rest-channel.md` (1 site, SKIPPED-HOTFILE), `lanes/hotcrm.md` (2 charter blockquotes, KEEP), `lanes/cli.md`, `lanes/devx.md`, `lanes/engine.md`, `lanes/services.md`, `lanes/skills.md`, `lanes/spec.md`, `release-aftercare.md`, `review-checklist.md`, `state-machine.md`, `true-green.md` (0 sites each — every span hand-checked). **No file in the surface is left partially classified.**
- **Cross-reference repairs (non-site, mechanical, one commit):** nine phrases of the form 原话见 X / 出处原话逐字住 X pointed at words this PR converts; each drops the 原话 limb in place (`SKILL.md` ×6, `decision-analysis.md:11`, `dispatch-runbook.md:85`, `lanes/director.md:67`). No rule text changed, no line re-wrapped.
- Nothing written carries an issue number, a comment id or a URL; `check:pm-skill-id-lint` stays at 23 files clean.
